newsitem.title: UK: BoE to issue 28-day bills for several weeks.
newsitem.headline: BoE to issue 28-day bills for several weeks.

text.p: The Bank of England said on Friday it will issues 28-day Treasury bills for the next several weeks.

It said the move was "a technical adaptation to the regular programme of Treasury bill issues, designed to smooth the future pattern of daily market shortages/surpluses, and taking particular account of the large redemption of 5.6 billion stg of 8.75 percent Treasury loan stock 1997 on September 1."
The bills may be taken up on any day of the week following the tender in the usual way, the Bank said.
